Raspberry Clafoutis
By: Zora
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:29am

Ingredients




1/3 cup Sugar plus, 2 tablespoons
1/3  cup All-purpose flour
4 large Eggs
1/3 cup Milk
3 teaspoons Vanilla
1/3 teaspoon Almond extract
1/3 teaspoon Salt
1/3 cup Raspberries
1/3 cup Blackberries
1 tablespoon Unsalted butter cut into bits
Vanilla ice cream

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees. 2 In a bowl, combine 2/3 cup of sugar, flour, eggs, milk, vanilla, almond extract, and salt until the custard is just smooth. Arrange the raspberries and blackberries in one layer in a buttered 6-cup gratin dish or flameproof shallow baking dish, pour the custard over them, and bake the clafouti in the middle of the oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the top is puffed and springy to the touch.
